address: Wych Cross, Forest Row, East Sussex,RH18 5JR
bio: Ashdown Park is a beautiful country house hotel set in the heart of the Ashdown Forest in East Sussex. Set in 186 acres of landscaped Sussex countryside, it is surrounded by immaculate lawns, secret gardens, lakes and woodland trails.  The Park enjoys a colourful and eventful past. A listed 19th century mansion house, it has been variously a hospital and convalescent home for First World War soldiers, a training house for nuns and an international university. Today, it's one of England's favourite country house hotels.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Drawing Rooms with roaring log fires in winter and a terrace for alfresco eating during the warmer months.
